newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Second person dies under Australia euthanasia law.
newsitem.headline: Second person dies under Australia euthanasia law.

text.p: A second person has died under a euthanasia law in the Australian outback region of the Northern Territory, the Australian Broadcasting Corp (ABC) radio service said on Monday.
Dr Robert Marr of the Coalition for Voluntary Euthaniasia said Mrs Janet Mills died last Thursday after she administered a lethal dose of drugs, assisted by euthanasia campaigner Dr Philip Nitschke.
Mills had appealed to the medical community before Christmas for a specialist to give her the approval she needed to go ahead with the procedure.
The ABC said her death was not announced until Monday in order to give the family time to grieve privately.
Cancer patient Bob Dent was the first person to take his own life under the regional law, which took effect in July 1996 and has been opposed by politicians in the national parliament.
